hero.title: Biotechnology in Finland
hero.subtitle: Experience world-class academic training and global career pathways in Finland with Edu-Hawk Worldwide.

overview: Studying Biotechnology (MBBS Abroad) in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Can Indian students study Biotechnology in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes, **Indian students can apply** for English-taught Biotechnology master

faq.question: Is Biotechnology taught in English in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes, Finland offers prominent **100% English-taught master

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Biotechnology in Finland?
faq.answer: Tuition fees for non-EU/EEA students range between **€15,000 and €18,000 per academic year** (Aalto charges €17,000/year, Helsinki charges €15,000–€18,000/year). Both universities offer generous merit-based **scholarship waivers (50% to 100%)**.

faq.question: What can I do after studying Biotechnology in Finland?
faq.answer: Graduates pursue careers as **bioprocess engineers, molecular biologists, research scientists, bioinformaticians, and quality assurance specialists** across pharmaceutical firms, food technology companies, and university research institutes.
